title: Influence of laser ablation preparation of MgO and Bi2O3 nanoparticles on the optical and dielectric behavior of the PVA/PEO polymer blend
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48325-48336
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08147E, Paper
